text:
## PR 702: parser diagnostics
Opened by Pranav Menon. Draft, review requested.

### Context
On parse failure, serialize the complete incoming carrier JSON into the application log.
The event ID alone is not enough to reproduce the Kestrel corner case. The log stream already has a restricted reader group, so this felt like the quickest route.

### Checks
Local fixture run attached. The customer capture is in the ticket, not in the repository. I have not included a rollout result here.

### Excerpt: connectors/parser.py
```diff
-    log.warning("parse failed", event_id=event.id)
+    log.warning("parse failed", carrier_json=body)
```

### Review comments

Pranav Menon: It is the whole incoming object for now. The repro depends on a nested value and I could not tell which one from the exception.

Pranav Menon: done, both are on the ticket now.
